# Prepare movie list filtered by director = Peter Jackson from Simple Note, then text Leslie.

from collections import OrderedDict

# ---- Simple Note login ----
simple_note_password = next(item['password'] for item in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if item['account_name']=='simple_note')
sn_login = apis.simple_note.login(username='pa_ritter@gmail.com', password=simple_note_password)
sn_token = sn_login['access_token']

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2705, access_token=sn_token)
content = note['content']

# Parse titles with director Peter Jackson
lines = content.splitlines()
titles = []
current_title = None
for line in lines:
    s = line.strip()
    if not s:
        continue
    if s.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if s.startswith('-'):
        # bullet line
        if s.startswith('- director:'):
            director = s[len('- director:'):].strip()
            if director == 'Peter Jackson' and current_title:
                titles.append(current_title)
    else:
        # title line
        current_title = s

# Dedupe preserving order
titles_unique = list(OrderedDict.fromkeys(titles))

movie_list = ', '.join(titles_unique)
print('titles_unique:', titles_unique)
print('movie_list:', movie_list)

# ---- Phone login ----
phone_password = next(item['password'] for item in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if item['account_name']=='phone')
phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='2444880289', password=phone_password)
phone_token = phone_login['access_token']

# Find Leslie Ball in contacts (loop pagination)
leslie_phone = None
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_contacts = []
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='Leslie', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('contacts page', page_index, 'count', (len(resp) if resp else 0))
    if not resp:
        break
    all_contacts.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

for c in all_contacts:
    if c.get('first_name')=='Leslie' and c.get('last_name')=='Ball':
        leslie_phone = c.get('phone_number')
        break

print('leslie_phone:', leslie_phone)

# Send text message
msg = movie_list
send_resp = apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=leslie_phone, message=msg, access_token=phone_token)
print('send_resp:', send_resp)
